Kai: Quick follow-up from PM: recurring vendor auth throttles -> model-registry 401/429 cascades -> regional stickiness blocking failover. Need owners + one verification step to close.
Maya: Agree. list owners and minimal deliverables pls.
Liam: I can own vendor comms & SLA ask. Will open SR and request historical throttle windows.
Arjun: I'll own client fixes: singleflight for refresh, cap concurrent refreshes, and split 401/429 handling with jittered backoff. ETA: 3 business days.
Tess: I'll own routing: reduce sticky-routing TTL to 20s for model flows and add explicit alternate-region fallback on auth-error. 10% canary for 48h. ETA: 5 business days.
ops-bot: Follow-up incident recorded: INC-2025-10-12-175. Reminder set for owners in 72h.
Kai: Verification: infra to run synthetic 429-injection job in staging and report PASS for 3 consecutive runs before closing items.
Liam: SR opened: SR-71002. Will paste vendor reply in the follow-up doc.
Arjun: Quick pseudo I'll implement: singleflight refresh, cap concurrent refreshes=3, backoff: base*2^attempt + rand(0,base) and extra delay for 429. 401 -> immediate refresh + one retry.
Tess: Canary plan: 10% traffic -> 48h -> monitor p95 latency and token-miss rate; rollback if p95 > baseline * 1.10 or token-miss > 0.8%.
Kai: Action list to track in postmortem follow-up doc: A1 Arjun PR+tests (3bd), A2 Liam SR+summary (7bd), A3 Tess routing canary (5bd), A4 Infra synthetic job (4bd), A5 Kai update postmortem & dashboard (EOD next business day).
deploy-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Auth Resilience Follow-up" Thu Oct 16 10:00am PT. Invite: Kai, Maya, Liam, Arjun, Tess.
Maya: Keep updates in the follow-up doc not here. We'll reconvene at the check-in. :thumbsup:
